items.title: The degree of a finite locally free module of constant rank on a proper curve equals the degree of its first Chern class capped with the fundamental class

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the degree of a finite locally free module of constant rank on a proper curve over a field with the degree of its first Chern class capped with the fundamental class (statement lines 8098-8108, tag 0AZ3). The proof is a careful three-stage reduction: first over the irreducible components, then along a modification after which the module becomes a successive extension of invertible sheaves, and finally to a single effective Cartier divisor, where the computation of the right hand side as a sum of residue weighted lengths is converted into dim_k Gamma(D, O_D) by the pushdown formula. Each stage uses a different additivity statement and none of them is the lemma itself, so the claim is H2.
